name: Catalog-Registry-Prompt Synchronization Guard
description: Triggers whenever a catalog or registry file is saved to verify 1:1 parity between defineCatalog() Zod schemas, defineRegistry() implementations, and system prompt fingerprints.

action.prompt: A catalog or registry file was modified. Verify Invariant 2 (Catalog-Registry-Prompt Tri-Synchronization): ensure every component in defineCatalog() has a strict Zod object schema, a non-empty description, and a matching implementation in defineRegistry(), and run `pnpm typecheck`.
